data.body:
[P2] Preserve terminal delivery for existing plugins

These notifications run before replay creates nested parent spans, and `_report_terminal_update` claims delivery even when a plugin raises. With the pre-change `InvocationOtelPlugin`, a normal `wait_for_callback` resume therefore raises `No parent span found`; deduplication suppresses delivery when replay subsequently visits the callback, losing its terminal span. The new OTel deferral logic fixes the coordinated package upgrade, but existing API-version-1 plugins remain affected. Make eager delivery opt-in or versioned, preserve visit-time delivery for older plugins, and add a nested callback suspend/resume regression to the installed legacy-plugin tests.
